briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate AGI race as DialectForge protocol gains traction in security

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid model iteration amid regulatory scrutiny. Compute scaling and multi-agent systems dominate headlines this week.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning; Anthropic's Claude 4.1 and Meta's Llama 4.5 compete on benchmarks. xAI Colossus cluster powers Grok-3 training.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp and TSMC 2nm capacity expansions drive new data center builds. Google TPU v6 pods now online in multiple regions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for BCI and automotive CAN bus deployments by 2028?
